card.name: Units and dose-form words in dosing text
card.fires_on: Words that finish a unit or product form inside dosing text, such as mg in a dose formula, "ial" in GVOKE Vial, and "injection" or "Solution" after a drug name.

modes.label: Unit in a dose formula
modes.description: mg or mcg closing a bracketed or parenthesized dose in a calculation.

modes.label: Vial name ending
modes.description: The "ial" in a branded Vial product name.
modes.example: GVOKE V<<ial>>Dx in patients with diabetes mellitus

modes.label: Dose form after drug name
modes.description: Injection, oral or solution right after a drug name.
modes.example: 10 mg/mL voriconazole for<< injection>> concentrate is added

card.plain: It fires on the last word of a dose unit or product form, like mg, Vial, or injection, in dosing text.
